faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for EdCIL Senior Consultant (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the EdCIL Senior Consultant (IT) position is 06 August 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their applications well before the deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Consultant (IT) posts in EdCIL?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Senior Consultant (IT) post in EdCIL (India) Limited. This recruitment drive is for a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Consultant (IT) position?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Senior Consultant (IT) post should not be more than 35 years of age as on 30 June 2026. Please refer to the official notification for any age relaxation details.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for Senior Consultant (IT)?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a full-time regular Bachelor's (B.Tech./B.E.) in Computer Science Engineering/IT/Software Engineering/AI/AI & Machine Learning with at least 60% marks. A Master's or Ph.D. in related fields is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Senior Consultant (IT) at EdCIL?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Consultant (IT) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 per month. This is a competitive salary for a contractual government position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: According to the official notification, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the EdCIL Senior Consultant (IT) Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Consultant (IT) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Consultant (IT) position includes evaluation of academic qualifications, professional qualifications, relevant experience, and a final interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these criteria.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the EdCIL Senior Consultant (IT) Recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of EdCIL (www.edcilindia.co.in). The application process involves filling out the online form, uploading documents, and submitting it before the last date.
